programs.title: How To Lose Weight Well 3
programs.desc: Another installment of the program in which Dr. Xand van Tullekenem and the world-famous dietitian Hala El-Shafie help participants lose excess weight using diets prepared especially for them.A doctor checks whether the bacteria in our gut may actually be the key to weight loss, tests the popular DASH diet and assists a pair of gym friends who want to lose weight.Viewers will also learn interesting facts about, among others:Gwyneth Paltrow's cleansing diet, the weight loss plan proposed by the British Health Service, the impact of alcohol on our weight and interesting gadgets for fitness exercises.

programs.title: The Price of a Perfect Body with Olivia Attwood 2
programs.desc: Another installment of the program in which reality star Olivia Attwood reveals the behind-the-scenes of surgery.It exposes the risks associated with the surgeries people undergo to achieve the perfect body.

programs.title: Grand Indian Hotel
programs.desc: The creators of the documentary visit luxury Indian hotels, whose employees do their best to provide the highest quality of services.Cameras accompany staff in various unusual challenges.

programs.title: World's Most Secret Homes
programs.desc: Viewers will see original houses located in unique corners of the world.Among them are a cabin hidden in the mountains in Norway and a mysterious building built deep in the Brazilian forest.
